- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Political Discontent: Many Europeans are disillusioned with traditional political parties, leading them to support populist parties that promise to disrupt the status quo.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In summary, the complex interplay of economic, social, and political factors contribute to the rise of populism and nationalism in European politics.
